<MethodEndpoint

  path={"/api/circles/{circleId}/members"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Members only — who is in a circle is itself sensitive, so this is
gated on your own membership rather than on group membership. A
circle you're not in returns `404`, the same as one that doesn't
exist.
